description:
Correct every rustdoc, comment and document that states where an event append lands, so each says the log's committed length.

## Background

Event appends land at the log's committed length, the end of its last newline-terminated line. Restatements still say "the log's length", "the captured length" or describe a torn-tail refusal: `crates/jit/src/storage/redo_record.rs:39`, `repository_state/image.rs:138-147,1113`, `repository_state/initialize.rs:401,422`, `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs:2817`, `dev/architecture/repository-state-materialization.md:271-275` and `docs/reference/storage-format.md:99`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each listed rustdoc, comment and document says that an event append is positioned at the log's committed length, and none describes a torn-tail certification or refusal.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Append-position prose says committed length
